jd:
Financial Planning Analyst - Meadowlark Health Systems

About the role
Meadowlark runs a network of clinics and needs a planning analyst for its finance team. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build budgets and forecasts
- Explain variances to budget holders
- Produce management reports

Requirements
- Financial modelling in Excel
- Variance analysis
- Forecasting
- Budgeting
- Healthcare finance experience

Nice to have
- Power BI

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
